# Using a password manager

Reusing a password means one leak opens every account that shares it.

## One vault

The manager generates a long random password per site and fills it in. You remember only the vault's own password.

## Two factors

Protect the vault with a second factor, such as an authenticator app, so a stolen master password is not enough.
